To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a nylon mesh can be used in the regenerator of a pulse tube cryocoler at temperature around 80 K and that a nonmetallic pulse tube cooler can be made for some special applications, for example, SQUID-cooler without cryogenic liquids.
nylon mesh is not suitable for the regenerator matrix in metallic PTC, and an entirely nonmetalic PTC is an option for SQUID cooling.
nylon mesh can be used as a regenerator in a pulse tube cryocools and the cooling performance is better than that of the conventional stainless steel mesh.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, fabrication and performance of nonmetallic coax PTC.
the development of nonmetallic cryogenic devices, especially nonmetallic pulse tube cryocools.
the development and testing of a coaxial PTC using a nylon mesh regenerator matrix, and the performance is discussed in detail.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nylon mesh is not a promising regenerator matrix for PTCs.
nylon mesh is an alternative material for regenerator matrix in cryocooler, but it is not suitable for high frequency pulse tube coolers.
a nonmetallic PTPC can be designed and operated successfully.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of nylon mesh in PTC is not recommended.
the nylon mesh is suitable for the PTC cold heads at temperatures around 100 K, but the performance of nylon-mesh regenerator is not as good as that of stainless steel mesh.
the nonmetallic cold end is feasible and nylon mesh is not a good choice as regenerator matrix for the nonmetallic PTP.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of nonmetallic regenerators depends on the mesh type and the operating temperature range.
the nonmetallic cold heads can be made to be as good as metallic cold heads, if the nonmetallic regenerator is designed properly.
nylon mesh can be used as a regenerator in a nonmetallic PCT, but its performance is significantly worse than stainless steel mesh.
